categories.main_business_segments: Five Below operates as a single reportable segment focused on specialty value retail, offering a broad assortment of trend-right, high-quality merchandise primarily targeted at tweens and teens. The company organizes its products into eight 'worlds': Style, Room, Sports, Tech, Create, Party, Candy, and New & Now, with further reporting by product groups: leisure, fashion and home, and snack and seasonal.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Five Below does not manufacture its own products but relies on a dynamic and disciplined sourcing strategy, purchasing from approximately 1,000 vendors, with about 60% of goods sourced domestically and the remainder imported, primarily from China. The company leverages a centralized merchandising and product development team, advanced inventory planning and allocation processes, and a network of large-scale distribution centers (shipcenters) to ensure rapid response to trends and efficient supply chain management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are tweens and teens, though the store's appeal extends to younger children, parents, and value-oriented shoppers of all ages. Five Below targets customers seeking affordable, trend-driven merchandise, with a focus on self-expression and frequent, independent purchases by younger shoppers.
categories.geographic_coverage: As of February 1, 2025, Five Below operated 1,771 stores across 44 U.S. states, with a presence in urban, suburban, and semi-rural markets. The company also sells nationwide through its e-commerce platform and mobile app, with distribution centers strategically located in Arizona, Georgia, Indiana, New Jersey, and Texas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Five Below operates as a downstream retailer, positioned at the end of the supply chain, selling directly to consumers through its stores and online channels. The company manages its own distribution and fulfillment centers but does not engage in manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include aggressive store expansion (targeting over 3,500 locations long-term), driving comparable sales through dynamic merchandising, increasing brand awareness via digital and community marketing, and enhancing operating margins through supply chain efficiencies and cost leverage. Innovation is centered on rapid trend response, digital engagement, and continuous improvement of the in-store and online customer experience.
categories.revenue_model: Five Below generates revenue primarily through the sale of merchandise in its physical stores and online, with most products priced at $5 or below, though select items are priced higher. E-commerce sales, including shipping and handling, are included in net sales, and the company also utilizes third-party delivery services for online orders.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Five Below competes with a wide range of retailers, including discount, mass merchandise, grocery, drug, convenience, variety, specialty stores, and online retailers. Key competitors include Dollar Tree, Dollar General, Walmart, Target, and Amazon. The company differentiates itself through its focus on the tween/teen demographic, trend-right merchandise, and a unique, high-energy shopping experience.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal 2024, Five Below reported net sales of $3.88 billion, up from $3.08 billion in fiscal 2022, representing a 12.3% CAGR over two years. The company opened 227 net new stores in fiscal 2024 and plans to open approximately 150 new stores in fiscal 2025. Despite strong top-line growth, operating income decreased from $345 million in 2022 to $323.8 million in 2024, and comparable sales declined by 2.7% in 2024 after a 2.8% increase in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Five Below offers a compelling value proposition by providing a constantly refreshed assortment of trend-right, high-quality products at low price points, primarily $5 and below. The company emphasizes a fun, discovery-driven shopping experience, targeting the influential and resilient tween/teen segment, and leverages its ability to quickly respond to trends and deliver exceptional value through flexible sourcing and merchandising strategies.
